name: Adaptability
description: Boosts the power of moves of the same type as the Pokémon by 100% instead of 50%.

name: Aerilate
description: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Aftermath

name: Analytic
description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's moves by 30% when the Pokémon is the last to move that turn.

name: Anger Point
description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat to its sixth stage when the Pokémon takes a critical hit.

name: Anticipation

name: Armor Tail

name: Aroma Veil

name: Battle Armor
description: Attacks landed on the Pokémon will never be critical hits.

name: Berserk

name: Big Pecks
description: The Pokémon's Defense stat cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or Abilities.

name: Blaze

name: Bulletproof
description: The Pokémon is immune to ball and bomb moves.

name: Cheek Pouch

name: Chlorophyll
description: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

name: Clear Body
description: The Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or Abilities.

name: Cloud Nine

name: Competitive
description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 2 stages.

name: Compound Eyes

name: Contrary

name: Corrosion

name: Cud Chew

name: Cursed Body

name: Cute Charm

name: Damp

name: Defiant
description: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted by 2 stages.

name: Disguise

name: Dragonize
description: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

name: Drizzle

name: Drought

name: Dry Skin
description: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP. However, the Pokémon takes 25% more damage from Fire-type moves. The Pokémon has 1/8 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in rain, but it loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn in harsh sunlight.

name: Early Bird

name: Earth Eater

name: Eelevate

name: Effect Spore
description: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.

name: Forecast

name: Friend Guard

name: Hydration

name: Pure Power

name: Rough Skin

name: Sand Rush

name: Sand Veil
